content: We have carbon NMR data with chemical shifts. Need count of methyl groups in the molecule. Methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm (sp3). In data we have peaks at 37.50, 36.39, 26.41. Those are likely aliphatic carbons. Methyl groups typically ~10-20 ppm, but can be up to 30. 26.41 could be a methyl attached to aromatic? 36-37 likely methylene or tertiary carbon. Need to infer structure? Could also retrieve carbon shift ranges for functional groups to identify methyl. Let's retrieve carbon shifts for methyl groups.
